title: Scoreboard Decoupling
description: Move a check that must wait out of write() and into a run_phase thread fed by analysis FIFOs, then account for every item at end of test.

steps.title: Step 1: Run the coupled starter
steps.instructions: Read `src/dv/scoreboard.sv`, predict the log, then run `src/dv/testbench.sv`. Expect one `SCB/NO_RSP` error per request (10 to 100 ns) and `SCB/NO_TRAFFIC`: `write_req()` runs in zero time, before the response exists.

steps.title: Step 2: Try to wait in write()
steps.instructions: Add `@(rsp_in)` or `wait (last_rsp != null)` inside `write_req()` and compile. The compiler rejects a time-controlling statement in a function (IEEE 1800-2023 §13.4). Remove it.

steps.title: Step 3: Exports and analysis FIFOs
steps.instructions: In `scoreboard.sv`, make `req_in` and `rsp_in` `uvm_analysis_export #(my_txn)` members, add private `uvm_tlm_analysis_fifo #(my_txn)` buffers `req_fifo` and `rsp_fifo`, construct them with `new()`, and connect each export to its FIFO's `analysis_export`. Remove the imp declarations and the `write_*()` methods.

steps.title: Step 4: The run_phase thread
steps.instructions: Loop forever: `req_fifo.peek()`, `rsp_fifo.get()`, `req_fifo.try_get()`, then `check()`. Report leftovers in `check_phase` (`SCB/MISSING`, `SCB/UNEXPECTED`, `SCB/NO_TRAFFIC`). Expect `SCB_SUMMARY matches=10 mismatches=0 pending=0` at 130 ns and `UVM_ERROR :    0`.

steps.title: Step 5: Prove it can fail
steps.instructions: Run with `+CORRUPT=4`. Expect `SCB/MISMATCH` for seq 4 at 80 ns and `SCB_SUMMARY matches=9 mismatches=1 pending=0`. Compare your file with `solution/scoreboard.sv`.
